g.text: Traffic speed, density, and flow describe the same operating state through q=kv

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Hypothetical aggregate Greenshields relation v=v_f(1−k/k_j). q_max=v_fk_j/4=3,750 veh/h at k=75 veh/km,v=50 km/h. Two density/speed states can share a subcapacity
flow; the red point selects the lower-density branch. Values are illustrative for an unspecified aggregate stream and are not a roadway capacity recommendation.
